proposal.summary: Default Lansweeper installations (6.0.x through 7.2.x) leave the 'Built-in admin' enabled, allowing an attacker on the network to access admin functionality via the web console (Add New Package and Scheduled Deployments), resulting in command execution / remote code execution.
proposal.cwe_quote: By default, everyone in your network can access all of Lansweeper's features and menus simply by browsing to the web console URL and hitting the Built-in Admin button.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify installation configurations on a test instance to reproduce the default 'Built-in admin' behavior; collect PoC steps showing Add New Package / Scheduled Deployments leading to command execution and identify required network access; if confirmed, prepare vendor advisory and mitigations (disable built-in admin, restrict console access, apply patch).
